name: Gemini-Robotics-ER-2
_note: An embodied-reasoning model, which is what this benchmark asks about — the
only entrant trained for robot video rather than adapted to it.
A preview endpoint: the 1.6 version it replaces was shut down two months
after release. Scores cited from it should say when they were measured,
and the raw responses are what makes them checkable later.

thinking.note: Reports thoughtsTokenCount on every call and exposes no switch to disable it.
